notes: PHF AI READ HUB Batch 1. TOOL REGISTRY moi lib/ai-tool-registry.js (whitelist DUY NHAT, moi ten tool la mot adapter READ-ONLY, tu choi TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED cho bat ky ten la nao model tu bia). 6 tool: get_checklist_lowest_employees (co san), get_checklist_employee_issues + get_checklist_violation_summary (lib/ai-checklist-tools.js, reuse listChecklistViolations/getChecklistViolationWorkflowSummary/getChecklistMonthlyReport - khong tu dinh nghia lai cong thuc/policy lap lai), search_employees + get_employee_profile (lib/ai-employee-tools.js moi, reuse getChecklistReportAccess - CUNG nguon danh tinh voi get_checklist_lowest_employees), get_knl_profile (lib/ai-knl-tools.js moi, reuse listKnlPeople/resolveActorGrant - assessment:null tuong minh vi KNL Step 2 chua ton tai, khong bia). Employee identity: chon checklist_employee_assignments.employee_code lam nguon (xem TRACE report) - nhan vien chi co o Training Hub chua tung phan Checklist se khong xuat hien, gioi han da biet va cong bo. Structured response contract: api/ai/chat.js + server.js tra them field result (type ranking|employee_profile|alert_list|summary, xay o lib/ai-tool-registry.js#buildStructuredResult tu chinh tool result da whitelist - model khong tu tao duoc structured data). Frontend: tach engine dung chung assets/js/ai/phf-ai-engine.js (chat state + structured renderers: bang that cho desktop, list-card cho mobile qua .phf-ai-only-desktop/.phf-ai-only-mobile) - ca phf-ai-sandbox.js (trang day /admin/ai-sandbox) va phf-ai-floating.js (icon noi + panel, admin-only qua phfGetSessionRole/phf-auth-changed, khong doi route) deu goi CUNG 1 engine.mount(), khong co AI implementation rieng. Icon PHF AI hien la SVG placeholder (mat nguoi + circuit) trong luc cho asset PNG chinh thuc tu logo da gui - se thay the khi co file that trong assets/logo/. Khong sua file nghiep vu Checklist/KNL/Classroom/Training Hub/Auth/Router nao.
